speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) following vaginal delivery, likely ascending infection from prolonged labor.

I have reached my diagnosis limit and will not ask further questions. Please proceed with appropriate antibiotic therapy and follow-up as indicated for postpartum pelvic infection.
